PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Regulatory Reporting professional with 4.5+ years of experience supporting regulatory reporting, reporting analysis, data 
validation, exception management and stakeholder coordination within financial services. Experienced in MiFID II, Solvency II,

trade controls, trade notifications and exception management. Experienced in coordinating with clients, brokers and internal 
stakeholders to resolve queries and operational issues.
